title: 笔画和部首
intro: Chinese kids learn characters stroke by stroke. There are 8 basic strokes (点 横 竖 撇 捺 提 折 钩) and 7 stroke-order rules. Every character here is a picture (象形字) you will write from memory with stroke-by-stroke correction. Then 12 radicals (部首): the building blocks that tell you what a character is about.

items.note: 1 stroke: 横.
Top 横 shorter, bottom 横 longer. Rule: from top to bottom.
Middle 横 is the shortest, bottom the longest.
Rule: 先横后竖, horizontal before vertical.
Rule: 先撇后捺, left-falling before right-falling.
横, then 撇, then 捺.
Two 横, then 撇, 捺.
竖, 横折, then the bottom 横 seals it.
Rule: 先里头后封口, fill inside before closing the bottom.
Rule: 从外到内, frame first, then the two short 横 inside.
Middle 竖 first, then 竖折, then the right 竖.
Middle 竖钩 first, then left, then right.
Two dots first, then 撇, 捺.
横, 竖, 撇, 捺.
横, 竖, longer bottom 横.
竖, short 横, long 横.
横, 竖, 点.
The box first, the vertical through the middle last.
Rule: 先中间后两边, middle first, then the two sides.
撇点, 撇, 横.

items.en: water radical (三点水): rivers, washing, liquids · 河 洗 汤
person radical (单人旁): people and what they do · 你 他 们
hand radical (提手旁): actions done by hand · 打 拉 找
grass radical (草字头): plants · 花 草 菜
speech radical (言字旁): talking, words · 说 话 语
roof radical (宝盖头): houses, shelter · 家 字 宝
heart radical (竖心旁): feelings · 快 怕 忙
metal radical (金字旁): metals, money · 钱 铁 针
silk radical (绞丝旁): thread, cloth, some colours · 红 绿 线

十.h: A cross: all ten fingers crossed together, complete.

大.h: A person 人 stretching both arms 一 wide: this big!

天.h: The line 一 above a big person's head: the sky.

日.h: Old drawing of the sun ☉, squared off.

月.h: A crescent moon. As a left radical it often means 'flesh/body' (肚, 脸, 腿).

水.h: A stream in the middle with splashes on both sides. On the left it shrinks to 氵.

火.h: Flames with sparks flying off both sides.

木.h: A tree: trunk, branches and roots.

土.h: A sprout pushing up out of the ground.

上.h: A mark sitting above the ground line: up.

下.h: A mark hanging below the line: down.

中.h: An arrow through the middle of a target.

女.h: A woman kneeling with arms crossed (oracle bones).

子.h: A baby with arms out and legs wrapped in a blanket.

手.h: A hand with fingers spread. On the left it becomes 扌.

心.h: A heart with its chambers. On the left it becomes 忄.

门.h: A gate; the traditional 門 shows two swinging doors.

亻.h: 人 standing up straight to make room on the right.

扌.h: 手 squeezed onto the left side.

艹.h: Two sprouts of grass on top.

忄.h: 心 standing up on the left.

辶.h: A foot walking along a road; written last, underneath.

犭.h: A dog standing on its hind legs.

texts.title: 笔画歌

lines.en: A dot is like a little raindrop,
a horizontal is like a little carrying pole,
a vertical is like a little stick,
a left-falling stroke is like a little knife,
a right-falling stroke is like a little tail,
a turning stroke goes round a corner,
a hook is like a little fishhook.

notes: The 8 strokes: 点 diǎn (dot) · 横 héng (horizontal, left to right) · 竖 shù (vertical, top to bottom) · 撇 piě (falling left) · 捺 nà (falling right) · 提 tí (rising) · 折 zhé (turn) · 钩 gōu (hook).
Compound strokes combine them: 横折 (in 口), 竖钩 (in 小), 横折钩 (in 月, 门).

texts.title: 笔顺规则

lines.p: xiān lǐ tou hòu fēng kǒu rì
lines.en: Fill the inside, then seal the bottom: 日

lines.p: xiān zhōng jiān hòu liǎng biān xiǎo
lines.en: Middle first, then both sides: 小

notes: These seven rules predict the stroke order of almost every character. When in doubt, watch the animation in the dictionary.
Correct stroke order is not pedantry: it makes handwriting fast and lets you read other people's handwriting later.

exercises.why: 先撇后捺: left-falling before right-falling.
竖, 横折, then the bottom 横 closes the box.
从外到内: the frame (撇, 横折钩) before the two short strokes inside.
先里头后封口: middle 横 first, bottom 横 seals it.
All about water: river, wash, soup.
亻 单人旁 = person. (彳 双人旁 is a different radical about walking.)
大人 adult · 大山 big mountain · 大小 size.
人口 population · 门口 doorway · 山口 mountain pass.
小心 means 'careful' (small heart → watch out).
A line 一 above a big person 大: the sky above our heads.

scenario.title: 和爷爷练字
scenario.setting: Grandpa is teaching you to write with a brush. Answer his questions about stroke order.

a.npc: 来，我们写「人」字。先写哪一笔？
a.p: lái wǒ men xiě rén zì xiān xiě nǎ yī bǐ
a.en: Come, let's write 人. Which stroke comes first?

opts.fb: In 人 the 撇 comes first.

a2.npc: 不对哦，再想想。人字先写撇，再写捺。
a2.p: bù duì o zài xiǎng xiang rén zì xiān xiě piě zài xiě nà
a2.en: Not quite, think again. 人 is 撇 first, then 捺.

opts.p: hǎo xiān xiě piě zài xiě nà
opts.en: OK: 撇 first, then 捺.

b.p: xiě de zhēn hǎo dà zì ne

opts.p: xiān xiě héng zài xiě piě hé nà
opts.en: First the horizontal, then 撇 and 捺.
opts.fb: 大 = 横, 撇, 捺.

opts.p: xiān xiě rén zài xiě héng
opts.fb: The 横 comes first in 大.

c.p: hěn hǎo nǐ kàn zhè shì shén me zì
c.en: Very good! Look, what character is this? (Grandpa writes 口)

opts.fb: Right: an empty box is 口.
日 has a stroke inside; 口 is empty.

d.npc: 对了！今天写得很好，给你一块糖！
d.p: duì le jīn tiān xiě de hěn hǎo gěi nǐ yī kuài táng
d.en: Right! You wrote well today: here's a sweet!
